statement: Let R, Q ⊆ B(H) be von Neumann algebras with identity I, with R amenable. If R ⊂γ Q and γ < 1/100, there is a unitary v ∈ (R ∪ Q)′′ such that vRv∗ ⊆ Q, ∥v − I∥ ≤ 150γ. If also Q ⊂γ R and γ < 1/101, the same conclusion holds with vRv∗ = Q.
